parole.significato: O God; vocative form of الله (allāh) used in invocations, oaths, etc.
parole.testo: Extended form of الله (allāh). The origin of the ـُمَّ (-umma) is unknown. Most likely, it is a fossilized remnant of a vocative particle—akin to the very common vocative particle يا (yā)—which would have been productive in earlier Arabic.
